Frequently Asked Questions

HSR Utility (a brand of HSR Energy Private Limited) builds beautifully designed devotional wallpaper and ringtone apps for Android. Our apps are Pakiza (Islamic wallpapers and nasheeds) and Arul (South Indian devotional wallpapers and ringtones).

Pakiza offers a curated collection of HD and live Islamic wallpapers with ringtones and nasheeds. Arul offers HD and live South Indian devotional wallpapers and ringtones across six deities — Amman, Ayyappan, Murugan, Perumal, Sivan, and Temples. Both are Android apps built by the same team.

Both apps are being prepared for the Google Play Store. Email us at support@hsrutility.com and we'll let you know when each one goes live.

Yes — browsing and previewing every wallpaper and ringtone is completely free in both apps. An optional premium plan unlocks setting wallpapers, setting ringtones, and saving.

Both apps use Sign in with Google. We only receive your name, email, and profile photo to create your account — we never ask for a phone number or password.

Email us at support@hsrutility.com and mention which app (Pakiza or Arul). We read every email and reply within 48 hours.

You can request permanent deletion of your account and data for either app at any time. Visit our Delete My Account page for full step-by-step instructions.

Go to Delete My Account

Both apps support Android 7.0 (Nougat) and above. We recommend keeping your device updated for the best experience.
